page: Amazon Web Services c9g.4xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. Built on the 64-bit ARM architecture (arm64), this instance features 16 dedicated physical cores utilizing the AWS Neoverse-V3 CPU model running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, the instance provides dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading. The processor cache hierarchy includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache.

The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Network connectivity is managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor, delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. Cryptographic operations are accelerated through hardware-supported AES instructions.

As an ARM-based compute-optimized instance, the c9g.4xlarge offers high resource density and power efficiency inherent to the Graviton architecture. The dedicated physical core layout makes it highly suitable for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from predictable single-threaded performance and low-latency cache access. Typical workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, media encoding, and distributed analytics where a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio is optimal.
